helper_version: A086 independent reconstruction v3; own v2 Fraction/log-prime utilities only; no author checker imports
family: Actual balanced-core point activations, first-positive Boolean combs, and fresh selector of disjoint actual Boolean children

domain.activation: balanced cores n=1,2 with r=1..5; n=3 with r=1..3; 250 pairs, three references each
domain.comb: all 256 two-bit leaf pairs; 256 triples (i,j,(i+j) mod 16); all 544 equal-spectrum triples; scalar sign strings a=1..8 (1020)
domain.disjoint: all 256 ordered two-bit child pairs with two calibrated reference variants

symmetry: None; squared-spectrum grouping only selects the stated equal-spectrum hypothesis
arithmetic: Fractions; exact entropy as linear combinations of log2 primes; outward atanh rational logarithm intervals (48 terms); analytic tail for activation r>=6
